MLPerf EDU currently registers **14 workloads** in **14 families** across **7 suites**. Every page in this section is generated from the [workload registry](https://github.com/harvard-edge/cs249r_book/tree/main/mlperf-edu/registry); the registry YAML is the single source of truth for models, datasets, quality targets, and public-result status.

## Graph Learning (`graph`)

Graph neural network training on sparse adjacency structure, exercising irregular memory access patterns that dense workloads never touch.

| **Workload** | **Suite** | **Model** | **Params** | **Dataset** | **Variants** | **Candidate result status** |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| [`graph-node-classification`](../benchmarks/graph/graph-node-classification.qmd) | graph | ogb-gcn | 110K | ogbn-arxiv | — | experimental |
